code:
SELECT FirstName GivenName, LastName Surname
FROM Person.Person;
caption: This works too — but a missing comma here becomes very hard to spot.
A calculation has no natural name — the alias is what makes it readable.

code:
SELECT FirstName AS [Given Name]
FROM Person.Person;
caption: Square brackets let an alias contain a space.
